mapper.update: UPDATE org_position SET position_code = #{positionCode}, position_name = #{positionName}, position_category = #{positionCategory}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(), is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
